question: R2: the page scroll after a resize at the other south corners (se, sw) after a move that scrolled the page; and how long the moved block is remembered: a second south resize after scrolling back to the top, and a south resize after a plain move of another block that did not scroll. X2: touch let go off a handle, Shape se 70,70 and s 65 down, Text se 60 down and ne 60 up, held 150 ms. Each read twice (A, B; T1, T2).
answer: R2, twice each (A, B; blocks from earlier runs stayed in the section): after a tall Shape was moved down while the page scrolled (to 8/2/24/8), a new Shape's se pulled 246 down, let go on that block's right edge, did not scroll; its sw, on the left edge, scrolled 233, the moved block's bottom at the frame's bottom. After a plain move of the new Shape a row down, its s pull still scrolled 233. The 'twice' runs' second pull pressed the moved block's body, not the handle, and moved it: not read. X2, twice each: by touch held 150 ms, a Shape pulled se 70, 70 (to 1/2/9/9) or s 65 down (1/2/8/8), and a Text pulled se 60 down (a row more) or ne 60 up (no change) all stay selected.
